testcase.name: default capacity holds exactly ten seconds of pcm16 mono at sixteen kilohertz
finish input returns without waiting for queue storage work
offer copies only requested bytes and preserves fifo at exact capacity
offer rejects negative oversized and odd pcm byte lengths
zero length offer does not allocate a queued block and closed input rejects it
concurrent offer and cancel leave no queued bytes
finish input is idempotent and drains accepted blocks before returning null
cancel wakes a blocked consumer and discards queued blocks even after finish
disk spool preserves block fifo and drains before finished input
disk capacity rejects new pcm and frees backlog budget as blocks are consumed
spool io failure is explicit and cancel close purge the session directory
orphan sweep skips an active locked spool and reclaims it after close
failure to reclaim a consumed segment is reported instead of losing quota accounting
